metadata.artifact_scope: One artifact reference per content-store object, labelled by its producing operation and output; per-file payload digests are in metadata.execution.phases[].artifacts.
metadata.containment_scope: Groups contain operations and sources; a field is contained by the operation whose artifact provides it. Containment folds the canvas and asserts no value dependency.
metadata.edge_scope: Declared operation reads and compiler dependencies; not individual-output formulas or observed runtime access.
metadata.evidence_scope: Recorded graph/receipt keys and store payload digests checked; no kernel replay, signature verification or release certification.

execution.history: Only supplied phases are recorded; absent earlier computation is unknown.
execution.verification: Recorded graph/receipt keys and store payload digests checked; no kernel replay, signature verification or release certification.

metadata.status_scope: Gate badges appear only on gate kernels. The cache badge summarises every supplied phase: a computing phase is named before replays are counted, and a reuse-only badge does not claim the operation never computed earlier.
